description.value: A popular family park near Squamish with four freshwater lakes, sandy beaches, and dramatic mountain backdrop; demand is intense July–September so reserve well ahead — the park fills even on weekdays.

raw_osm.name: Alice Lake Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Alice Lake is an active provincial campground with 55 vehicle-accessible campsites and one group camping area with electrical hook-ups, corroborating OSM tags power_supply=yes. Reservations are explicitly recommended on the website, and food availability is supported by the website's note that the closest store is 6km away in Brackendale. The OSM phone number and internet_access=yes tag could not be directly confirmed from the fetched website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Alice Lake Campground'; the BC Parks website refers to the broader entity as 'Alice Lake Park' — the campground is a component of the park, so this is a minor distinction but may affect how the listing is searched.

OSM capacity (96) is higher than the 55 vehicle-accessible campsites mentioned on the website; the group camping area and possibly walk-in or overflow sites may account for the difference, but this could not be confirmed from the fetched content.
Phone number (+1-604-986-9371) from OSM was not found in the fetched website content and cannot be confirmed as current.
OSM tag internet_access=yes not explicitly corroborated by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Provincial Park campground on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor with confirmed electrical hook-ups, reservation system, and nearby services; a clear fit for the WWC directory for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: four freshwater lakes, sandy beaches, and dramatic mountain backdrop
